name: MaxEco - Workflow E: Weekly Management & Liquidity Report

parameters.jsCode:
// MaxEco Node E.5: Format Executive Markdown & Solvency Report
const payload = $input.first().json;
const m = payload.metrics;
const ms = payload.milestoneSummary;

const inr = (val) => '₹' + Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN');
const now = new Date();
const reportDate = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const overdueList = m.overdueInvoices.length > 0
  ? m.overdueInvoices.map(i => '* ⚠️ **OVERDUE**: Invoice (' + i.id + ') — ' + i.clientName + ' | ' + inr(i.amountDue) + ' due on ' + i.dueDate).join('\n')
  : '* ✅ No overdue invoices.';

const reportMd = '# MaxEco Energy & Tech — Weekly Management & Liquidity Report\n' +
  '**Report Date**: ' + reportDate + ' | **Location**: Maligaon, Guwahati, Assam\n\n' +
  '---\n\n' +
  '## 1. Cash-Basis Liquidity & Solvency Summary\n' +
  '> **Rule Enforced**: Unpaid invoices and pending quotes are NEVER counted as cash on hand.\n\n' +
  '| Financial Measure | Amount (INR) | Governance Notes |\n' +
  '| :--- | :--- | :--- |\n' +
  '| **Real Cash Collected in Bank** | **' + inr(m.realCollectedCash) + '** | Physically cleared customer funds |\n' +
  '| **Direct Project Costs Paid** | (' + inr(m.directProjectCosts) + ') | Contractor, site survey & delivery costs |\n' +
  '| **Gross Profit on Real Cash** | **' + inr(m.grossProfitCash) + '** | Collected Cash minus Direct Delivery Costs |\n' +
  '| **18% Statutory Tax Reserve** | (' + inr(m.taxReserveAllocated) + ') | Ring-fenced reserve for tax obligations |\n' +
  '| **Operating Overheads** | (' + inr(m.operatingOverheads) + ') | Office, internet & recurring tools |\n' +
  '| **Founder Living Drawings** | (' + inr(m.founderDrawings) + ') | Personal allowance (kept separate) |\n' +
  '| **NET AVAILABLE CASH RUNWAY** | **' + inr(m.netAvailableCash) + '** | **Net Liquid Operating Balance** |\n\n' +
  '---\n\n' +
  '## 2. Receivables & Collection Warnings\n' +
  '* **Total Billed Invoices**: ' + inr(m.totalBilled) + '\n' +
  '* **Outstanding Receivables (Uncollected)**: **' + inr(m.outstandingReceivables) + '**\n' +
  '* **Overdue Customer Invoices**: ' + m.overdueInvoices.length + '\n\n' +
  overdueList + '\n\n' +
  '---\n\n' +
  '## 3. Commercial Pipeline & Quotations\n' +
  '* **Quoted Pipeline (Non-binding)**: ' + inr(m.quotedPipelineTotal) + '\n' +
  '* Active Quotations: ' + payload.quotations.length + '\n\n' +
  '---\n\n' +
  '## 4. Project Delivery Milestones\n' +
  '* **Solar Projects**: ' + ms.solar.completed + ' completed, **' + ms.solar.pending + ' pending action**\n' +
  '* **IT & Web Projects**: ' + ms.it.completed + ' completed, **' + ms.it.pending + ' pending action**\n\n' +
  '---\n' +
  '*Confidential Internal Document — Generated by MaxEco Automated Systems*';

return [{
  json: {
    reportDate,
    reportMarkdown: reportMd,
    metrics: m,
    milestones: ms
  }
}];
